Package frc.robot.subsystems.elevator

Class ElevatorSubsystem

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
frc.robot.subsystems.elevator.AbstractElevatorSubsystem
frc.robot.subsystems.elevator.ElevatorSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem, AutoCloseable
public class ElevatorSubsystem extends AbstractElevatorSubsystem
Elevator subsystem backed by a leader/follower pair of motor controllers.

The encoder, limit switches, PID controller, and feedforward controller are supplied by the caller, allowing the subsystem to be configured for different robots without changing the class.

  • Constructor Details

    • ElevatorSubsystem

      public ElevatorSubsystem(edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.motorcontrol.MotorController leader, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.motorcontrol.MotorController follower, boolean followerInverted, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.Encoder encoder, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.DigitalInput lowerLimitSwitch, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj.DigitalInput upperLimitSwitch, edu.wpi.first.math.controller.PIDController pid, edu.wpi.first.math.controller.ElevatorFeedforward feedforward, double lowerLimit, double upperLimit, double startingHeight, double distancePerPulse)
      Creates a real elevator subsystem.
      Parameters:
      leader - leader motor controller
      follower - follower motor controller
      followerInverted - whether the follower should be inverted
      encoder - quadrature encoder measuring elevator position
      lowerLimitSwitch - active-low lower limit switch, or null
      upperLimitSwitch - active-low upper limit switch, or null
      pid - injected position controller
      feedforward - injected elevator feedforward controller
      lowerLimit - lower travel limit in meters
      upperLimit - upper travel limit in meters
      startingHeight - initial target height in meters
      distancePerPulse - encoder distance-per-pulse conversion
